set system host-name JUNIPER.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set firewall family inet filter 3001.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term 1.explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

from source-address 10.11.11.1/32.explanation: Configures the source address conditions for access to the control list.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Number of subnet masks in source IP address.

then accept.explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

family inet filter output 3002.explanation: The command applies an IPv4 firewall filter (`family inet filter`) to outgoing traffic (`output`) using the specified filter name (`[parameter3]`).
